array.string: case " $(/usr/sbin/sysctl -n kern.bootargs) " in *" snapintosh_shell=1 "*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; F=/private/var/tmp/snap-diag.log; echo "diag start $(/bin/date +%s)" >>$F; (while :; do /usr/bin/log stream --style compact --predicate 'subsystem == "org.snapintosh.adreno" OR ((process == "loginwindow" OR process == "WindowServer") AND messageType == fault)' 2>&1 | while IFS= read -r l; do printf 'diag: %s\n' "$l" >>$F; done; sleep 10; done) & while :; do sleep 45; { echo "diag-poll $(/bin/date +%s)"; /bin/ps -axo pid,pcpu,rss,comm | /usr/bin/sort -k2 -nr | /usr/bin/head -8; /usr/sbin/ioreg -l -w0 -r -c AdrenoDisplay | /usr/bin/grep -o '"AdrenoDisplayStats" = {[^}]*}'; for f in /private/var/tmp/adreno-*.log; do echo "== $f"; /usr/bin/tail -2 "$f"; done; } >>$F 2>&1; (/usr/bin/tail -c 1500 $F >>/dev/console 2>/dev/null &); (/usr/bin/tail -c 1500 $F >/dev/cu.debug-console 2>/dev/null &); done
